description: Check whether a draft is ready before spending anything on it. Returns a 0 to 100 readiness reading, the suggested work type and up to six objective questions about what is still missing. Runs on a single cheap model and needs no API key, so it is the right first call when a user asks if a paper, case report, thesis chapter or teaching material is good enough yet. For the score that counts, with three reference models and eligibility for a citable record, call evaluate_text afterwards. Gatilho em português: "meu texto já está bom o suficiente".

text.description: Draft to screen, in the original language. Long texts are trimmed, never refused.

name: screen_text
title: Screen a draft before measuring it
